Berger Converge IV.prose:
The Converge IV is the most powerful of the Berger weapons, and an effective late-game choice for the primary weapon slots. Although it is only a barely more than half as powerful as the similarly-priced Tyrfing Blaster, it has an extremely large advantage in terms of range over the Tyrfing Blaster (about 2.5x as much range). The Converge IV gives you the same range as the weapons that the enemy carries, giving you ability to exchange fire with them evenly rather than close in. Its damage is not up to standards with its price, but its range makes up for the damage lost since you can begin firing 2.5 times earlier. The Converge IV is a slow-firing weapon though, so it is not advised for players with poor accuracy.

The Converge IV is an effective mid-game alternative to more expensive Kaamo Club weapons such as the Dark Matter Laser and M6 A4 Raccoon.

This weapon has a slow fire rate, yet it packs a really powerful punch.

Berger Focus I.prose:
The Berger company is one of the pioneers of stellar weapons technology, including lasers. The company flooded the market every 50 years with a series of new weapons in various designs to suit every budget.

Trivia: This is the weakest of laser of the Berger company. Like all the Berger lasers it has got a slow firing rate but it packs a punch. NPC Void ships fire shots that are identical to this weapon

Berger Focus II A1.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Berger company is one of the pioneers of stellar weapons technology, including lasers. The company flooded the market every 50 years with a series of new weapons in various designs to suit every budget.

## Notes
*The Berger Focus II A1 is the successor of the Berger Focus I laser gun.
*It looks like a Dark Matter Laser.

Berger Retribution.prose:
## In-Game Description
This relatively strong laser gun from the Berger company has one of the fastest rates of fire on the market, second only to the Converge series of weapons.

## Notes
The game's description for this item is quite misleading. Although it states that the Berger Retribution has one of the fastest rates of fire on the market, this is only true when compared to other laser weapons of the same type. It also states that it is second only to the Converge series of weapons. While the Converge IV (the only weapon from the Converge series to appear in the game) surpasses the Retribution in several areas, including damage, rate of fire is not one of them as the description implies.

## Trivia
*The model of this laser has two barrels, but when fired only one shot is spent, or the two shots merge together to form one big shot.
*In HD version of this game, the Berger Retribution seemed to be the standard weapon of the Nivelian star fleet.
*The Disruptor Laser also fires similar projectiles to the Berger Retribution, but with a higher intensity.
*The weapon's appearance resembles a double-barreled pump-action shotgun.

Dark Matter Laser.prose:
## In-Game Description
Nobody really knows who built this extremely dangerous primary weapon or who introduced it to the market. Even though Deep Science has already assigned a whole research team to this task, the scientists in charge have not yet been able to gather any usable information on the Dark Matter Laser's unique configuration and functionality. Consequently, the origin and operating mode of this mysterious device do still remain a mystery.

## Trivia
*It resembles the Berger Focus II A1 in shape, implying that it may be produced by Berger in discreet as their latest blockbuster before its technology and copies were distributed to known owners and vendors such as Jakk Zoboon and the Black Guard.
**It is notable that the Dark Matter Lasers used by Black Guard NPC ships do significantly less damage.
*The Dark Matter Laser can only be purchased from Jakk Zoboon in the Kaamo Club Space Lounge.
*The laser shot of the Dark Matter Laser (black with a green aura) is very similar, if not exactly the same, as the shot from the Overwatch Standard Issue Pulse Rifle from the game Half-Life 2.

Disruptor Laser.prose: ## Trivia *The Disruptor Laser is one of the best weapons to build and resell. The best strategy for doing this is stockpiling materials on Kaamo Station. *This weapon was created by Khador's friend Netor. *The wavelength of 438.511 nanometers corresponds to a vibrant blue color, between hexadecimal values #0500FF and #0200FF. *If you look closely at this weapons specifications it shares many of the same values with other weapons. It has the same rate of fire as the Gram Blaster, the same Damage as the Berger Retribution and nearly the same range as theM6 A4 "Raccoon". *Despite Maxwell being tasked by Netor to obtain the Void Essence for this weapon, it is not used and Maxwell gets to keep it. *Despite the description, NPC ships do not actually have shields. *The projectiles of the Disruptor Laser is similar to that of the Berger Retribution, but with a higher intensity. *Disruptor Laser has the highest fire rate out of all Laser weapons, though it is surpassed by the Dark Matter Laser and M6A4 Raccoon in terms of DPS.

Gram Blaster.prose:
## In-Game Description
Terran engineers are responsible for bringing the amazing Hervarar series of weapons to market. The Gram Blaster is deadly, easy to use, and looks damn good.

## Trivia
*"Hervarar" is derived from the Hervarar saga ok Heiðreks (The Saga of Hervar and Heidrek), a saga of Norse mythology. This saga was an source of inspiration for J. R. R. Tolkien's stories.
*The name "Gram" is shared with a magical sword from Norse mythology.
*The Midorian Most Wanted Criminal Nombur Talénah used a dismounted Gram Blaster to kill 4 of his comrades because they questioned the Nivelian government.
*While this is pure speculation, it could be possible that weapons used on ships could also be used for anti-personnel purposes as Nombur Talenah used this blaster to kill 4 others also the Targe shield states that it was used for personal protection which could make it possible that some weapons were used for anti-personnel usage and have been repurposed for ship-based combat instead of person-based. This might then became the history of every blaster made after.
*The only weapon are on par with this blaster on range was the H'nookk.

H'nookk.prose:
## In-Game Description
The H'nookk is one of the Vossk's deadliest blasters. It consumes so much energy that the old H'Soc fighter had to be rebuilt because all the Vossk warriors wanted to equip their ships with this weapon. That was before the Hervarar series hit the market, which offers greater power with less energy consumption.

## Notes
1t H'nookk is required for the HH-AT "Archimedes" blueprint.

K'booskk.prose:
## In-Game Description
The K'booskk is the successor to the N'saan. It is more efficient in every area of performance and is definitely preferable to its little brother.

## Notes
Despite the statement in the in-game description, the K'booskk is only slightly better than its predecessor the N'saan, dealing the same base damage with only a minor loading speed advantage.

M6 A3 \"Wolverine\".prose:
## In-Game Description
Beam weapons are the sniper rifles of the cannon world. A good aim is rewarded with the greatest penetrating power of all automatic primary weapons.

## Trivia
This weapon, unlike others (one shot), instantly hits the enemy without delay. Although this weapon is very low in DPS, it is possible to destroy an enemy with this weapon with one blast with a ship that has four weapon slots.

## Trivia
*The Wolverine looks like the M6 A1 "Wolf", possibly because 1x M4 A1 "Wolf" is required for the Wolverine blueprint.
*This the succesor of the M6 A2 "Cougar" and the predecessor of the M6 A4 "Raccoon".

M6 A4 \"Raccoon\".prose:
## In-Game Description
The M6 A4 is the most powerful laser beam in the entire galaxy. If you've mounted several of these lethal devices to your ship, you will be able to pulverize your enemies before they are even close enough to open fire on you. In most cases, a single shot of the M6 A4 is all it takes to turn your target into space dust.

Mass Driver MD 10.prose:
## In-Game Description
Alongside Thermo-weapons, the Mass Driver MD 10 has the fastest rate of fire on the market. Unfortunately, its production requires vast quantities of resources, so the weapon is increasingly rare and a popular target for thieves, who steal them from unattended ships.

## Notes
1t Mass Driver MD 10 is required for the Icarus Heavy AS blueprint.

## Trivia
*At one round every 0.09 seconds or approximately 666 rounds per minute, the Mass Driver MD 10 has the highest fire rate of all weapons.
**Despite this fact, the NPC who sells its blueprint claims to know one that fires even faster. This could be a subtle foreshadowing to Mass Driver MD 12's description, which claims it is "the deadliest ballistic weapon that is legally available on the market", implying the existence of superior alternatives that are still in use.
*Though the description says that it is a popular target for thieves, there is no such mechanic where items can actually be occasionally stolen from the player's ship.

Mass Driver MD 12.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Mass Driver MD12 is by far the deadliest ballistic weapon that is legally available on the market. The penetration power of the Mass Driver's projectiles is significantly enhanced by an artificial coating which the bullets receive only moments before they're fired off. This procedure results in a damage rate that is absolutely unrivalled for this kind of weapon.

## Trivia
*Despite its description, the Mass Driver MD 12 is only avaliable from Jakk Zoboon in the Kaamo Club Space Lounge. It cannot be found elsewhere.
*This weapon can be considered the successor to the Mass Driver MD 10, with whom it shares projectile textures with.
*This is the weapon used by a Blue Fyre in the Supernova Challenge, along with 2 Mimung Blasters.
*Though the most powerful ballistic weapon by sheer DPS alone, the Mass Driver MD 12 has the second highest fire rate at 0.1 seconds per round or 600 rounds per minute.

Micro Gun MK II.prose:
## In-Game Description
Even 2000 years after their invention, ballistic weapons still haven't disappeared from the scene. The Micro Guns from this category of weapon are very good value.

Mimung Blaster.prose:
## Trivia
*The Mimung Blaster can only be purchased from Jakk Zoboon in the Kaamo Club Space Lounge, even if you do not have the supernova pack.
*Two of them are used by a Blue Fyre in the Supernova Challenge, along with a Mass Driver MD 12.
*It shoots purple rings of energy.
*The Mimung is the name of the sword wielded by the famous Norse character Wudga.

N'saan.prose:
## In-Game Description
N'saan in Vossk means, "little stab" and is a garden variety blaster weapon.

## Trivia
*It is required as a blueprint component for the H'nookk.
*The N'saan blaster is the predecessor of the K'booskk blaster.
*It is the lowest level blaster.
*It can be found on most Vossk stations.

Ridil Blaster.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Ridil Blaster comes from the famous Hervarar series and is the faster version of the Gram Blaster. It's less powerful but has a slightly faster firing rate.

## Notes
Despite what is stated in the description, the Ridil Blaster deals just as much damage as the Gram Blaster. It has an increased firing rate, making it a very powerful weapon, although its range has been reduced by 300m compared to the Gram Blaster, turning the range from short to downright abysmal.

## Trivia
* The Ridil Blaster is the successor to the Gram Blaster and predecessor of the Tyrfing Blaster and Mimung Blaster.
* The Ridill is a sword wielded by the dwarf Regin in Norse mythology.

Scram Cannon.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Scram Cannon is one of the fastest firing guns in the market. The technology is so simple that anyone could build one of these weapons from scratch, but it is still preferable to get an original design, handmade by droids.

## Notes
The Scram Cannon is the highest level auto-cannon that can be found in shops. It is a powerful weapon but is relatively weak in comparison to much cheaper laser weapons and blasters. It comes in handy if you find yourself in firefights often. If you don't particularly care about the rate of fire and you've got the credits, the Mass Driver series is a better choice.

The Scram Cannon can't be crafted, although the description implies it can.

Tyrfing Blaster.prose:
## In-Game Description
This weapon is the pinnacle of the Hervarar series - almost as deadly as the Gram Blaster, but much faster. In the wrong hands, this weapon poses an enormous threat.

## Notes
Like the Ridil Blaster, the game's description of this weapon falsely implies that this weapon deals less damage than the Gram Blaster. In reality, the Tyrfing Blaster surpasses the Gram and Ridil Blasters in both damage and loading speed. Like the Ridil Blaster though, the Tyrfing Blaster has less range than the Gram Blaster, something that the Gram Blaster lacks in the first place. In terms of damage, the M6 series all do more, but less per second. Its range makes it only useful once you have closed in on the target.

D'iol.prose:
## In-Game Description
Vossk-armor is considered the best of its kind in the known Universe and no other race has managed to successfully reproduce it. The D'iol armor is being used more and more often by engineers in the Terran fleet.

## Trivia
*According to its description, the T'Suum's casing is made with D'iol armor.
*The D'iol is the best armor available if the T'yol's blueprint has not yet been found.
* 2 D'iol armour plating can be looted by destroying the pirate's hideout at Bosméh orbit in the Weymire system. This process cannot be repeated as the pirate's hideout will be eradicated forever in the orbit after having been destroyed.

E4 Ultra Lamina.prose:
## In-Game Description
This armor is for pilots who want the best possible value for money. Offers adequate protection for most combat situations.

## Trivia
* E4 Ultra Lamina is the armor preinstalled into your Inflict or Berger CrossXT when you start a new game from Valkyrie or Supernova, along with a Riot Shield.

E6 D-X Plating.prose:
## In-Game Description
The use of hardened DX particles from ancient asteroids is responsible for the E6 armor's special resilience. The cost of this type of armor plummeted a few years ago when a technique for creating the DX particles under lab conditions was discovered.

T'yol.prose:
## In-Game Description
An ultra-hard armor from the Vossk elite production. This armor is the pride of Vossk industry and provides the strongest protection in the galactic market today. T'yol means "forehead", not to be confused with T'yool, which refers to the Vossk sex organs. This mix up has been the undoing of many an unfortunate trader...

## Trivia
*The representative image of the T'yol appears to be luminescent in its grooves, a property exclusive only to this armor.
*It is noticed that the person selling the blueprint got the plans from a Most Wanted Criminal.
*Despite the armor looking extremely thick from the picture, it is actually not as that strong and can be drained very fast if you are being attacked by multiple enemies at the same time.
*All Vossk equipment and weapons are good for any part of the storyline in the game, they also produced the best armor, sentry gun (T'Suum), mine (Ksann'k), booster (Me'al, in base game) and turret (L'ksaar, in base game).

Aegir.prose:
The Aegir is the Nivelian's flagship vessel. It is perfection, elegance and power all rolled into one. It is not a cheap ship by any means, but is highly sought after by a lot of pilots across the galaxy.

Trivia: Aegir is the name of a Scandinavian sea god. Aegir is the name of a sea giant, god of the ocean and king of the sea creatures in Norse mythology. The Aegir bears a resemblance to the Vic Viper in Gradius. This is one of the two Nivelian ships that have four secondary weapons. This is oddly not the agilest of the ultimate ships, being less agile than the VoidX and the Mantis.

Anaan.prose:
## In-Game Description
This ship is often used to transport expensive goods or important politicians. It has a large cargo space and can handle itself when it comes to combat.

## Trivia
*When the player hires wingmen with Anaans, they will always have Vossk Organs and can be EMPed for their cargo. Therefore, it would be advisable to seek Terran wingmen. A way to get rid of wingmen quickly to get more is to bring them into enemy space or destroy them when not in their faction's territory.
*The Anaan is used as the Terran Bomber MK. I in Galaxy on Fire: Alliances.
*The Anaan is the only ship currently in Terran Fleet to have double letters together.

Azov.prose: ## In-Game Description This ship is essentially a "Groza Lite". Lighter, more agile, but also less dangerous and smaller than its big brother. It is still a very popular ship for mercenaries and pirates. ## Trivia *The Darkzov is the successor to the Azov. *Azov is a sea (Sea of Azov) and also a Russian town. *It is a Starter Ship. *An Azov and 2 Hiros attack you in the prologue scene of the game. *In the GOF2 HD trailer, the Azov displays an armour statistic of I50000000.

Badger.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Badger is a solid ship built by the Mido. With primary and secondary weapon slots, it can be a formidable opponent.

## Trivia
*The Badger is a Starter Ship.
*It has the name of a Terran animal.
*It has the typical 'nose down' cockpit Mido design.
*The Badger resembles the Nuyang II, with a similar cockpit and a similar engine layout.

Berger CrossXT.prose:
## In-Game Description
After the Mido rebellion, the Berger firm saw a good business opportunity and unleashed the Berger CrossXT on the Mido System's open market. A balanced battle ship for a small budget, the ship sold well and a successor is already in the pipeline.

## Trivia
*Gunant Breh's ship is a Berger CrossXT.
*Although classified as a Mido ship, the Berger CrossXT is actually manufactured by Berger, a Terran company.
*The Berger Cross Special is the successor of this ship, available only in the Kaamo Club .
*The Berger CrossXT in Java looks like a swing wing from [http://www.starwars.com Star Wars].
*It is a Starter Ship.

Dark Angel.prose:
## Notes
The Dark Angel is the new ship brought by Fishlabs in GOF2. This ship was originally planned to appear in Supernova add-on as one of Most Wanted criminals' ships, but it was cut being considered bland and unimagined. Design-wise, the Dark Angel’s biggest characteristic is the unorthodox shape of its airfoils, which is a little reminiscent of the wings of an angel; hence the name of the ship. It’s also due to this advanced shaping that the Dark Angel is surprisingly swift and agile despite its heavy armor and massive plating. It can be found in Terran territory, mostly in the Aquila System or in the Union system (Android).

## Trivia
*The Dark Angel is the best Terran ship for fighting in the base game.
*The Dark Angel differs from the default Terran paint-job, which is a gray ship with yellow markings on it, due to the fact that it was an incomplete prototype.
*The wings of the Dark Angel are similar to those of the Ghost. It's backstory is also similar, both being abandoned in prototype stage.
*This ship is never used by NPCs.
*The Dark Angel resembles a real military gunship. However, Its weapons are aimed at the front instead of its side.
*Despite the description, Davilion is very active in GOF3, which is set after GOF2.

Furious.prose:
## In-Game Description
A light, basic Terran ship, made more appealing by the possibility of installing a turret.

## Trivia
*The cockpit section looks like an Icarus Scout Class II form GOF3D.
*It is a Starter Ship.
*The Furious has a cockpit that looks a lot like the Star Wars T-65 X-Wing fighter, a renowned starfighter from any science fiction universe.
*In the J2ME version of the game, this ship was called "Furious Flounder" due to its fish-like appearance.

Groza.prose:
## In-Game Description
“The Groza may not look like much, but it is a well-equipped and very dangerous ship. The large cargo space makes it a common choice among trigger-happy traders.”

## Notes
A better, modified version of this ship, the Groza MK II, can be acquired from the Kaamo Club.

## Trivia
*"Groza" (Гроза) means "Thunderstorm" in Russian language.
*"Groza" means "Terror" in Polish language.
*The Groza MK II is a modified version of this ship that is better. However It can only be bought at the Kaamo Club.
*The Groza is one of only six ships that appear in both GoF2 and GoF3.
*The Groza is the Terran's Mk II Fighter in Galaxy on Fire Alliances.

Hatsuyuki.prose:
## In-Game Description
“It has little in the way of cargo space, but the Hatsuyuki is agile, heavily armed and very customizable. A masterpiece of Nivelian engineering.”

The Hatsuyuki is a ship of the Nivelian Republic. While about above-average in combat and customization ability, it is notable for its fragility from its small size and unconventional shape. In the standard Niveilan fleet, this ship is at the middle of the price range.

## Trivia
* The word "Hatsuyuki" comes from Japanese はつゆき(初雪), meaning "First Snow".
* The name is also shared with a destroyer that served during World War II, as well as an class of destroyers that were built in the 1980s for the Japanese Maritime Self-Defense Force (with one even being called Hatsuyuki).
* It is the smallest ship in the game.

Hector.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Mido regularly use the Hector as a light reconnaissance vehicle, and it is often found patrolling border areas. They are not very robust, and rarely used in combat.

## Trivia
*The Hector bears a mid-level resemblance to the P-38 Lightning, An American fighter plane (Lockheed Martin) used during World War II.
*It also bears some resemblace to the North American Rockwell [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_American_Rockwell_OV-10_Bronco OV-10 Bronco] , an American light attack aircraft
*It is a Starter Ship.

Hera.prose:
## In-Game Description
A relatively old Terran design, this ship is average in all respects, but some regard it as a classic.

## Trivia
*The Hera looks similar to a Icarus Scout Class II from GOF3D.
*This evident from the the wings, nose and rear section.
*It is a Starter Ship.
*In Greek mythology, Hera is the goddess of marriage.

Hernstein.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Hernstein is a dangerous battleship and is particularly popular with wealthy mercenaries.

## Trivia
*Hernstein is a town in Lower Austria.
*The Hernstein slightly resembles the OV-10 Bronco close air support fighter or P-38 Lightning.
*The Hernstein resembles a modified  Anaan.
*A marking in the rear closely resembles the symbol of the Nivelian Republic.
*It is one of the only 3 ships that has an "arch" or "spoiler" on the back, the other 2 being the Salvéhn and the Hector.
*It appears to have a gatling gun on each side of the wings, which may be a preinstalled Micro Gun MKII, it also somewhat looks like an GAU-8 Avenger gatling gun.
*This is the Pirate ship that has the highest cargo hold, which makes it reliable for trading and combat, before the player has enough credits to purchase the Rhino.

Hiro.prose:
## In-Game Description
A modified version of the Terran Inflict. At the expense of a primary weapons slot it has two secondary weapon slots installed.

## Trivia
*The Hiro is a good ship to buy after the Betty.
*The Hiro may be based off the Phantom, as both ships were modifications of the standard Terran fighter in their respective eras.
*Hiros seem to be second hand ships, If you look carefully at the Hiro's right side, you'll discover several bullet holes and scratches that seem to mark the impacts the former owner recieved while flying their ship.
*When using a Hiro you should always have homing missiles equipped(Edo, Intelijet) as this ship only has one primary weapon
*Two hiros are seen in the begining of gof2 story.

Inflict.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Terran fleet's most popular fighter. Cheap to manufacture and great looking.

## Trivia
*The Inflict has a striking resemblance to the Hawk, a Terran ship available in Galaxy on Fire 3D. The Inflict may simply be a later version of the Hawk, like the Zephyr and Razor 6. No such relationship between them is mentioned in the game, however.
*The design of the Inflict, as well as that of the Hawk and the Phantom all appear to be a nod to the design of the [https://galactica.fandom.com/wiki/Viper Viper] fighter from the Battlestar Galactica TV shows.
*This is the ship you first get on GoF2 Lite. This is also the starter ship when playing Valkyrie storyline.
*It is good ship to buy after the Betty.
*The nose, body and the canopy of the Inflict has a strong resemblance to the X-wing fighter of Star Wars.
*The Inflict is the Terran's MK I Fighter in Galaxy on Fire: Alliances.

Kinzer.prose:
## In-Game Description
A popular, customizable Nivelian ship, the Kinzer is equipped with the latest technology and can be personalized with a variety of modules.

## Trivia
*The Kinzer's original design in the Java game was used as the basis for the Aegir in the iOS version.
*The Kinzer is the Nivelian's heavy rocket ship.
**This is evident as it has the capabilities of 4 secondaries.
*The Kinzer RS is a modified version of this ship. It's only sold at the Kaamo Club.
*The kinzer has an extra thruster compared to the Kinzer RS.
*The Kinzer is used as Nivelian advanced interceptor in Galaxy on Fire: Alliances

N'Tirrk.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Vossk military designed the N'Tirrk to be a swift interceptor, whose heavy armor and immense firepower were particularly well-suited to take down battle ships and freighters. The body of the N'Tirrk is equipped with an experimental segment plating, which gives the ship a particularly aggressive look. Despite its enormous capabilities, the slightly overpriced N'Tirrk had been dismissed in favour of the less expensive S'Kanarr. Nevertheless, the Vossk military council has kept open the option to start mass-production on the N'Tirrk whenever a bigger quantity of this powerful gunship is needed.

## Notes
The N'Tirrk is the new Vossk bomber that was released by Fishlabs in GOF2. This ship was originally planned to appear in Supernova add-on as one of Most Wanted criminals' ships, but it was cut due to the Na'srrk being introduced. It is to be a good alternative to the H'Soc. The N'Tirrk only has 2 primary weapons, but its 4 secondary weapons can carry a lot of firepower. Its statistics are similar to the Teneta.

## Trivia
*In the description, it says that the S'kanarr is less expensive, but the opposite was true in-game.
**Or, it can refer to the fact that S'kanarr's absurd price was well-justified by it's capabilities, whist the N'Tirrk wasn't.
*This ship is great for beginners who want a good ship.
*It costs 198,000 in the Android version.
* The N'Tirrk looks like the abdomen of a katydid.
* There is a bomb hatch on the underside of the ship.
* In general, the speed and armour give it a good reason to be an interceptor, however, the H'Soc is still faster.

Nuyang II.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Nuyang II is an impressive ship. It is armed to the teeth, heavily armored and has plenty of room for cargo. If you are looking for a good Mido ship, and you have the Credits, there is no better option.

## Trivia
*This is the only Midorian ship that does not bear its faction symbol.
*This is the Base-Game ultimate ship for Mido.
*The engines on the wings look like the ones found on a Badger. The whole body resembles the shape of the Betty
*It can be assumed that this was a heavy mining vessel for Midorians before being weaponized.
*It looks similar to Boba Fett's ship, Slave I, from the Star Wars franchise.
*There is no Nuyang I or earlier model

Razor 6.prose:
## In-Game Description
The Razor 6 is the successor to the old Terran ship, the Zephyr. It has a greater emphasis on agility and weaponry, and there is only one cheaper ship with four mountable weapons brackets.

## Trivia
*When referring to the cheaper ship (in-game infobox), it most likely means the Dace.
*This is, besides the Type 43, the only ship with a number in its name.

Salvéhn.prose:
## In-Game Description
Originally designed as a research vessel, the Salvéhn has been modified for the military. Officially this ship is still a secret and you can make a lot of money selling one around here.

## Notes
This ship is a very good mid-game ship because of its balanced attributes.   
It is a good choice for a player who wants to install a Turret as soon as possible. The ship's main competitors are the Azov and the Furious, which are in the same price range and both have a turret slot. The Azov has an additional Secondary slot and greater handling, which the Salvéhn counters with an extra Equipment slot and a massive cargo hold, which is double the Azov's. In terms of price, the Azov is about 25,000-30,000 credits cheaper than the Salvéhn. Against the Furious, the Salvéhn has an extra Primary weapon, but has weaker Armor and Handling, as well as one less Secondary slot. The Furious costs about 15,000 credits less, and has about equal Cargo Hold and the exact same Equipment slot number. The Salvéhn is a slightly overpriced ship, but gives the highest Cargo Hold of the three, and can last into the mid-game, at which point the player should switch to the Velasco or Hernstein to take advantage of their Turret slots.

## Trivia
*The Salvéhn is the only Nivelian ship that has the ability to install a turret.
*The description says that this ship is a secret among others, yet it doesn't seem so since it's quite popular between the Nivelian security force. Or it could be a secret to other species/factions.
*It is a Starter Ship.
*The Salvéhn is used for both the basic bomber and advanced bomber of the Nivelian fleet in Galaxy on Fire: Alliances. While the basic bomber is the same in appearance as the Salvéhn, the advanced bomber is depicted with a dark blue/black paint job.
*Adding a thruster to increase maneuverability can be the deciding factor in life or death, as its low armor and low maneuverability makes it very easy to destroy. The armor and shielding at this stage aren't very efficient, so increased maneuverability will allow the pilot to escape. A booster is also a must have in order to get away.
*The Furious is a better choice for those who like to get into firefights as it has better armor and handling. However, the Salvéhn is better for traders as it has very slightly improved cargo space. The Salvehn has 2 primaries though it only has 1 secondary so pilots who prefer primaries over secondaries should use the Salvéhn instead if they are fine with decreased armor and maneuverability.
*The Salvéhn is the only Nivelian ship with an accent.
*The LOD version of this ship ('LOD' referring to the lower-poly version of the 3D models, which render when the ships are much further away from you) has a unique turret which in not present in the regular model. This could be because the devs originally planned to have a fixed turret on NPC Salvéhns but probably ran out of time, or didn't quite know how to implement them yet - and forgot to remove the turrets from the LOD models.thumb|Fully textured!thumb

Taipan.prose:
## In-Game Description
Like the Hera, the Taipan is more of a vintage offering than a practical choice. The ability to attach three primary weapons gives it a slight edge, however.

## Trivia
*Cornelius Tenner piloted a Tapian.
*The Taipan and the Hera are the two "Classic" ship designs in GoF2.
*Taipan is the name of an Australian adder.

Teneta.prose:
## In-Game Description
A heavy Terran rocket ship equipped with four secondary slots and room for a gun turret. It is a good deal because it's a bit older and doesn't have all the bells and whistles of a more modern ship.

## Trivia
*The Teneta's successor is the Teneta R.E.D.
*The round and circular cylinder on top of the Teneta is the Turret slot.
*The Teneta resembles a puffed up version of the Icarus Scout Class II from Galaxy on Fire 3D

Type 43.prose:
## In-Game Description
This ship was designed as a lightweight rocket ship and is often used by the Nivelian armed forces in large battles. This model has been slightly scaled back for the civilian market.

## Trivia
*Trot Lykkt piloted a Type 43 equipped with the prototype Disruptor laser that he had stolen from Netor.
*The Type 43 is used as Nivelian basic interceptor in Galaxy on Fire: Alliances.
*The ship is the only Nivelian ship to have a number in its name, and the only ship to do so in the game, apart from the Razor 6.
*The ship may be even stronger as said in the description but as a player we are unable to buy a military grade Type 43.

Veteran.prose:
## Trivia
*The empennage of the Veteran is similar to that of the SR-71 Blackbird.
*The Veteran's front resembles that of a Y-Wing Fighter from Star Wars.
*The Veteran can look like the YSS-1000 Sabre starfighter from Halo: Reach at certain angles. The four secondary weapon pods bear homage to the Sabre's two engine pods on its wings.
*The Veteran bears a resemblance to the Mig-31 from the film [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Firefox_(film) Firefox].
*The Veteran is a ultimate ship limited to 3 primary weapons, the other being Scimitar. It does, however, have a turret slot to counteract this, something that no other ultimate ship had before the S'Kanarr/Bloodstar.
*A Veteran equipped with three primary weapons and an auto-turret (ex. HH-AT "Archimedes") is arguably better than ships with four primary weapons, due to the turret's ability to fight without much input of the player.
*Despite its description saying that it is quite expensive, at some high-tech level stations, at least two Veterans can be seen in the security force. It is also the least expensive ultimate ship.
*Terran wingmen will occasionally pilot this ship.
*This starship is used as the Terran's Mk II Interceptor in the game Galaxy on Fire: Alliances.
*Unlike the Aegir and the Bloodstar, the Veteran's structural design in Galaxy on Fire 3 remained almost completely unchanged. It even retains some non-functional secondary slots.

Ward.prose:
## Notes
The Ward has a high number of module slots. It has high firepower too, but it is also very expensive.

Compared to the Nuyang II, the Ward has one more equipment slot and slightly better handling and it's also much more expensive. However, it has 80 fewer armor points and a far smaller cargo hold, which gives the Nuyang II a large advantage in trading and durability.

## Trivia
*Ward means to protect or guard.
*This is like an upgraded Razor 6.
*The Ward is particularly expensive, despite the description saying that it is perfect for most pilots.
*This is the Terran Interceptor MKI in Galaxy On Fire: Alliances.
*This is the only Terran ship with a one-syllable name.
*This is the ship used by the hijacker that kidnapped Thomas Boyle.

Wraith.prose:
## Trivia
*A Wraith is a ghost or ghost-like image.
*It is one of five Galaxy on Fire 3D ships that are included in Galaxy on Fire 2.
*The Wraith was added to Galaxy on Fire 2 at the same time as the Valkyrie expansion pack.
*In GoF2, the Wraith differs from normal Nivelian ship coloring, as it is grey/red instead of standard blue/grey.
*There is an incredibly rare glitch that allows the Wraith to appear in the Ko-on hangar only once. Once the game restarts by closing the app, the Wraith will no longer appear. This, unfortunately, is unconfirmed.
*Most Wanted criminal Vilhelm Lindon pilots this ship.
